strategy_roster.name: Elder Impulse
strategy_roster.notes: MACD histogram is represented by MACD minus its signal; long entries require price above EMA(13). The short side is omitted because this roster schema is long-only, and the documented stop is 2%.

strategy_roster.name: Rejection Candle
strategy_roster.notes: Long translation uses a bullish rejection candle with a lower wick at least twice the body; the bearish rejection is not encoded in the long-only schema. The documented stop is 2%.

strategy_roster.name: Volatility Adjusted Momentum
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(close,14) > sma(roc(close,14),20) + 2 * std(roc(close,14),20) and atr(high,low,close,14) > sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20)
strategy_roster.notes: Momentum is approximated with 14-bar ROC versus its 20-bar mean plus a 2-standard-deviation threshold, with ATR(14) expansion as the volatility filter. The malformed Unit(2...) stop is interpreted as 2%; no take-profit is documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Winner Pro
strategy_roster.notes: Uses the documented mean-reversion band/RSI concept with standard Bollinger(20,2) and RSI(14) defaults. Aroon and the unspecified MA filter are not available in the DSL; the optional stop is enabled but has no documented percentage.

strategy_roster.name: AO AC Trading Zones
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,20) and roc(close,5) > 0 and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: The unsupported SMMA teeth, Awesome/Acceleration oscillators, fractals, and five-level pyramiding are approximated by EMA(20) trend, positive ROC, and a bullish candle. The documented dynamic fifth-green-bar low stop is not expressible as a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Double Bottom and Top Hunter
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= 1.05 * donchian_low_prev(low,100) and close > open and close > sma(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: The repeated-low pattern is approximated by a bullish reversal within 5% of the prior 100-bar low and above SMA(20); the long exit uses a break of the prior 20-bar low. Short/top logic and the source's more specific new-high/new-low condition are not represented by the long-only schema.

strategy_roster.name: Time of day / day of week Sigma Spike
strategy_roster.notes: Absolute return z-score is expressed as the two-sided threshold; ROC is percent and the rolling standard-deviation length is 20. Hour/day-of-week filters are not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Bezier ReOpen
strategy_roster.notes: Bezier slope/re-entry is proxied by a close crossing the EMA(8) with positive one-bar momentum. Re-entry scaling and the absolute-price stop/take-profit parameters are not representable in the roster DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Forex Profit
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,10),ema(close,50)) and ema(close,10) > ema(close,25) and close > ema(close,10)
strategy_roster.notes: The EMA(10/25/50) alignment and prior-bar crossover are retained; close above EMA(10) is a documented Parabolic-SAR-direction proxy. Profit-threshold, trailing, and absolute-price-point stop/target logic are not expressible as percentage exits.

strategy_roster.name: Peter Panel
strategy_roster.notes: The source is a manual order panel with no automatic signals; a bullish completed-candle close is a minimal long market-toggle proxy. Entry-level, pending-order, modification, liquidation, and user-set protection controls are not representable in the DSL.
